In summary, our research is concerned with
the structural evolution of the Belt basin, a 1.7 Ga rift basin in the northern Rocky Mountains of western Montana, and its relation to the geologic history of the region.

the structural and stratigraphic history of the Belt Suprgroup, a thick, clastic sequence of sedimentary rocks in the western U.S. and Canada that was deposited in a series of rift basins between ca. 1.7 and 1.4 Ga.
